summary: A new crypto user received a purported tool through Telegram and bookmarked and activated it in a browser while using Axiom. The user's one SOL balance was drained after the interaction and the sender claimed the disappearance was a glitch.
user_mistake: activated an untrusted browser tool received through Telegram
prevention: Do not activate browser tools supplied through unsolicited messages / Use a separate low value wallet when testing unfamiliar Web3 tools
